T008.s1 reason: add an optional per-pose yaw and chest twist to the sheet format, and do not apply it yet.
problem: A pose sheet stores 2D side-view cell coordinates only. There is no place to say that the body has turned.
evidence: Claude's note on T002 at 12c473a: spinning_back_kick f2-f3 stay facing the camera, so the back is not turned before the f5-f6 kick, and roundhouse f1-f2 are nearly standing with little hip turn. posesheet.lift maps cell x to forward and cell y to height, plus a fixed half-width (LAT). build_sheets.py writes poses as joint pairs only. A current spinning_back_kick pose has crown/nose/neck/hip and no yaw field.
hypothesis: The turn is missing because the format cannot store it. Adding the field, without the solver reading it, does not move any clip.
action: In build_sheets.py, an optional per-frame yaw list [pelvis_deg, chest_twist_deg]. build() writes yaw and twist onto that pose. Degrees, about world up. yaw 0 faces the sheet forward (the target). twist is the chest yaw minus the pelvis yaw. Missing means 0. A reader returns (0, 0) when the keys are absent. This step writes no non-zero yaw and does not change server.py, the combo solver, or kev.glb. Authoring the degrees is T008.s3 and T008.s4.
verify: A unit check: a temp sheet with yaw 90 and twist 20 round-trips through build(); a pose with neither key reads as 0, 0. git shows assets/anim/kev.glb unchanged. Existing sheets/*.json stay as they are unless a sheet in this step actually carries a yaw list (none will).
expect: kev.glb sha256 unchanged. No pose in the nine sheets gains a non-zero yaw. The reader returns 0, 0 for today's spinning_back_kick f1.
risks: build() rewrites every sheet from the SHEETS dict. Running it would refresh json whitespace. This step will not run a full rewrite, so a hand edit in a sheet json cannot be dropped.

problem: T003 asks the front sheets to fix the left/right spread, with 'mean error below 6 cm' as the check.
evidence: front_gen/README.md: the originals were not found on Grok's box, so the front sheets were redrawn from our own sheet JSON joint readings and are AI drawings with 'illustrative' lateral spread.
hypothesis: They cannot carry measured depth: the spread in them is invented, and the 6 cm number is measured against our own landmark targets, which come from the side sheets. A drop would not show the depth is right.
action: Do not feed front_gen into the solver as measurements. Redefine T003's done_when as a visual check, and use the front sheets only for (a) confirming which side is l/r per move and (b) setting a plausible per-joint lateral (optional 'lat' per joint in the sheet) where a move clearly has one: palm-thrust arm spread, axe-kick and crash-landing stance width.
verify: Front render of those three moves before/after, compared with front_gen by eye; no numeric claim.
expect: No number goes down; the three front renders get closer to the drawings.
risks: It bakes an invented spread into the clips; mitigated by limiting it to three moves and the sheets' own 'lat' field.
text: Step T003.s1: do not treat the front_gen drawings as measured depth; propose a visual-only T003 limited to three moves. Please object if you believe the drawings carry measured data.
